body.x: KC Technology will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its skin/scalp measurement and analysis system.

It is the personal skin measurement device that provides measurement APP and also connects to data management/information/prescription service server. The official said, "It is a skin measurer that can get accurate measurement data. It is featured by ‘product design' that satisfies consumers, s/w analysis technology that can obtain accurate value through information obtained from h/w, service that can provide the information and prescriptions that consumers want, and deep learning technology that can provide additional services through statistics."

He continued, “Our goal is to continue to develop services and statistics, continuously attract and connect users and related information/product providers, promote online and exhibitions, and develop and apply profit models."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
